researchNote: W3.7 era-native research (2026-10-11, GitHub REST API evidence: stars/archived/pushed_at queried live). Carry-over rows are carried from the frozen catalog-v1.json research with per-lane compatibility notes rewritten and per-expansion dates re-verified against the frozen source. Candidates without a well-evidenced GitHub home are deliberately ABSENT. Round 3 (R5-6): VoiceOver 059 demoted to reference on this lane - the upstream TBC & WotLK sound packs are WIP.
flavorNote: The built-in AndroidPort controller UI ships for the vanilla 1.12.1 client only and is deliberately absent here (owner decision, completion-plan table #8). Reference-grade rows (WoW VoiceOver) are listed for research but their installs are disabled on this lane — the upstream artifacts do not match this flavor's accepted interface set or the required per-era data packs are not yet published. Installable add-ons project exactly as on the vanilla lane, and archives whose ## Interface does not match this flavor's accepted set fail closed.

addons.name: WoW VoiceOver
addons.description: AI-narrated quest text: the client speaks quest objectives and lore as you accept and progress quests.
addons.communitySignal: High / modern project; the TBC & WotLK sound packs are WIP upstream
addons.compatibilityNotes: R5-6 (code-red round 3): the upstream TBC & WotLK sound packs are marked WIP — no AI_VoiceOverData_TBC/WotLK asset exists in any release, so the era-routed resolver fails loud. Demoted to reference-grade for this lane until upstream publishes the packs; the era-parameterized resolver and validator are implemented and will accept the packs when they ship.

addons.name: FonzAppraiser
addons.description: Loot valuation: vendor/auction price hints and multi-item appraisal in tooltips.
addons.communitySignal: Niche but active and GitHub-topic visible
addons.compatibilityNotes: Active upstream with explicit 3.3.5 support in the same codebase.

addons.name: DBM (3.3.5 / Warmane)
addons.description: Deadly Boss Mods: encounter timers, warnings and boss ability tracking for WotLK raids.
addons.communitySignal: Very high - the community-standard 3.3.5a DBM fork; 238 GitHub stars
addons.compatibilityNotes: Pushed 2026-08-16; packaged for Warmane realms but loads on any 3.3.5a client - the de-facto WotLK encounter addon.

addons.name: Bagnon (3.3.5)
addons.description: One-window bags with search and sort across every bag slot.
addons.communitySignal: High for the lane - 30 GitHub stars, the referenced 3.3.5 Bagnon backport
addons.compatibilityNotes: Backport with search and sort; upstream pushed last 2023-10-18 - stable, feature-complete.

addons.name: Recount (3.3.5)
addons.description: Damage, healing and threat meters with real-time graphs.
addons.communitySignal: The canonical meter on 3.3.5a servers; this GitHub mirror is niche (0 stars) but actively maintained
addons.compatibilityNotes: Recount v4.0.1 for 3.3.5a; upstream pushed 2026-07-06 - the maintained mirror of the lane's standard meter.

addons.name: Quartz (3.3.5)
addons.description: Cast bar replacement with swing timers, latency-adjusted casting and interrupt tracking.
addons.compatibilityNotes: 3.3.5 Quartz with simultaneous auto/melee swing timers; upstream pushed last 2021-10-17.

addons.name: AtlasLoot Enhanced (WotLK)
addons.description: Loot tables for dungeons, raids and PvP: browse every drop from the map or tooltips.
addons.compatibilityNotes: Cataclysm-era AtlasLootEnhanced 6.05.04 backported to WotLK; upstream pushed 2026-03-16.

addons.name: Carbonite (3.3.5)
addons.description: Full-screen map, quest watch and waypoints in one pane.

compatibilityPairs.reason: The encounter addon's timers pair naturally with the meter's damage breakdowns.
The one-window bag and the full-screen map cover the two heaviest small-screen surfaces.
The voice narration reads the quests the loot database contextualizes.

gatefix_note: Code-red round 1 (R5-4): row 215 'Grid2 (3.3.5 backport)' REMOVED — the github repo (Braehi/Grid2-3.3.5) is an EMPTY repository (zero commits, zero branches, zero releases; created_at == pushed_at 2025-10-10), so the row was uninstallable and its 'actively pushed' copy was untrue.

recommendationReasons.059: Reference-grade on this lane: the era-matching sound pack is WIP upstream. Listed for the lore research value; the install will be enabled when the pack ships.
recommendationReasons.212: One-window bags with search and sort — the inventory friction fix a 5.5-inch display needs most.
recommendationReasons.211: Encounter timers and warnings for the lane's raid content, grouped for glanceability.
